name: Pin day low
note: Chartink translation, 4 Nov 2026 (Saurabh's 15-minute pin-bar scan, groups 2 and 4 folded into one): the last closed 15m bar's range is more than 3x its body, it has no upper wick (a green bar closing at its high, or a red bar opening at its high) and its low is the day's low: a long lower wick rejected at the low of the day. Chartink's [0] (forming bar) became off 1 (last closed bar), plus 09:45-15:00, price > 1000 and one alarm per stock per day, because the literal version rang 80-111 times a day. PARKED in scans/parked/ (the engine and API read only scans/*.json): move it up one folder to switch it on. Backtest 20 sessions (6 Oct-3 Nov 2026), stop = the bar's low, target 1:2, before costs. As Chartink has it (forming bar, all day, any price): 111 fires/day, target first 29 %, stop first 65 %, -0.10 R a trade, -14,460 INR at 1,000 INR max loss. This closed-bar version: 5.5 fires/day, 33 % target, -0.00 R, -2,108 INR; the 10:00 and 12:00 hours were mildly positive (38 % and 36 %), the rest negative. Parked: break-even at best.
